proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11572 vāla lists Hindi bāl, Gujarati vāḷ and Bhojpuri bār, and explicitly Gawri/Torwali bāl and Maiya bāla. These are hair comparanda; no similarly spelled word in another sense is included. The local form was checked against the Dardic comparanda in the full CDIAL article; no borrowing arrow was applied to this selected comparison.

The local form was checked against the Dardic comparanda in the full CDIAL article; no borrowing arrow was applied to this selected comparison.

The local form was checked against the Dardic comparanda in the full CDIAL article; no borrowing arrow was applied to this selected comparison.

The local form was checked against the Dardic comparanda in the full CDIAL article; no borrowing arrow was applied to this selected comparison.
